RACE SIMULATION — ACT 1 OF 1

THE UNIT: 0:30 @116-124% (attack the base) → 3:00 @102-109% (sustain the climb) → 8:00 @83-88% (tempo over the top) — this is the crux demand of the race: attack a shorter climb, sustain it, then hold tempo over the top.

THE SHAPE: 3 units across 1.7hr of Z2 — Act 1 of 1.

sessions.title: Rest Day — Race Week

sessions.description:
FUEL:
Normal meal ~2h before. One bottle, 40-50g carbs. Done.

2min Killers — level 2

WARM-UP:
• 5min ramp 50%->70% FTP
• 6min @85%-91% FTP
• 3min @45%-55% FTP
• 3x 20s @125% FTP / 40s @45%-55%
• 2min @45%-55% FTP

MAIN SET:
-6x 2min @ 125% FTP (Z6, RPE 9-10, 90-100rpm) / 5min @ 45%-55% (Z1, RPE 1-2)

COOL-DOWN:
-10min spin-down 70%->50% FTP (RPE 2-3)

EXECUTION:
-Commit to each effort, rest fully between.

NUTRITION:
-40-60g carbs/hr.

sessions.description:
FUEL:
Normal meal ~2h before. One bottle, 40-50g carbs. Done.

WARM-UP:
-18min building from Z1 to Z2

MAIN SET:
- 7min @ 65% FTP (Z2, RPE 3)
- 2min @ 120% FTP (Z5+, RPE 8-9)
- 3min @ 55% FTP (Z2, RPE 3)
- 3x0:30 @ 125% FTP (Z5+, RPE 8-9), 2min recovery @ 55% FTP (Z2, RPE 3)
-Cadence: 100-120rpm on the short stabs; 90-100rpm while riding easy

COOL-DOWN:
-15min easy spin Z1-Z2

EXECUTION:
-The 2-minute effort is controlled, not a test. Finish feeling more ready than tired.

sessions.title: Pre-Race Openers

sessions.description:
RACE DAY: Shawangunk Grit
Date: 2026-11-07

FUELING PLAN:
- Carbs/hour: 63g (range: [56, 70])
- Total carbs: 225g over race
- Start fueling at 20 min, every 20-30 min thereafter
- Pre-race: 100-150g carbs 3-4 hours before start

PACING STRATEGY:
- First 30 min: EASY. Let others burn matches -- I want you playing the long game.
- Mile 10-40: Find your rhythm. Target G SPOT zone (88-94% FTP) on climbs.
- Final third: this is where you pass people. Increase effort as others fade.
- Technical sections: Smooth > Fast. Avoid mechanicals.

COURSE INTEL:
- Surface: About 98-99% gravel once you enter Mohonk Preserve at mile two: historic carriage roads, rough and steep in spots, loose rock especially on the descents. Two miles of public road behind a pace car at the start.
- Features: Lenape Climb (Strava-timed segment: 1.47 mi, 433 ft, 5.
